data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Otho meaning 'wealthy' and the suffix -ilia meaning 'battle' or 'fertility'. In Greek mythology, Othilia was a warrior goddess associated with fertility and abundance. In Christian tradition, Othilia is revered as a saint who miraculously gave birth after a long period of infertility.
